posts.name: deddragon
posts.cooked:
I only played 1 game with Guise and unlocked Santa. Here’s my numbers, lets hope I counted right.

8: Number of turns I skipped to draw cards before taking an actual turn.
29: Total number of cards drawn by Guise
12: Total number of cards drawn out of turn when the unlock occurred
14: Total number of cards played
13: Total number of cards played out of turn (all in one environment turn)
29: Total number of cards in his trash at time of unlock
1: Card in the deck at unlock
8: Total cards in hand at time of unlock

Guise was not in the lead position. The final out of turn draw was off of Gritty Reboot.

The unlock is definitely linked to the draw so I have 2 hypotheses. The second one I did by accident; I wouldn’t have done these both in the same game if I was paying better attention.

  1. Play a game with Guise. Guise must draw 12 cards out of turn.
  2. Play a game with Guise. Guise must draw and/or play a total of 25 cards out of turn.

Can anyone naysay either of these?

Edit: The game was vs Mad Bomber Blade in Omnitron IV. One other number that may or may not matter 17: number of cards Guise discarded before the unlock

Also, never touched Wagermaster, so that's not part of it.

posts.name: smmoore06
posts.cooked:
Just unlocked.

I did not play one of everything. Also, I did not get it from card drawing. I had only drawn 8 cards when he unlocked and no cards were drawn to trigger the unlock. My team was, in order, Greatest Legacy, Argent Adept, SS Tachyon, Omni-x, Guise. I chained powers out of turn to let Guise play multiple cards as well. maybe thats part of it?

The cards I played, in this order and on these turns were:

  • Where Did I Leave That? (Played by Legacy)
  • Gimmicky Character (OmniX)
  • Best Card Ever! (OmniX)
  • Look What I Found (OmniX)
  • Lemme See That (Guise)
  • Selling Out (Guise)
  • Gritty Reboot (Using Selling Out)
  • Guise the Barbarian (Using Selling Out)
  • Uh...Yeah...I'm That Guy (Using Selling Out)
  • Gimmicky Character (a second time, on Legacy's turn)
  • Extreme!!! (Legacy)
  • I Can Do That Too! (Argent Adept)
  • I Can Do That Too! (a second time, still Argent Adept's turn)
  • Retcon (unlocked as soon as retcon was played. Both "I Can Do That Toos" and "Retcon" were played in the same chain using powers. Argent let Guise play ICDTT!, Guise used OmniX's power to play the second ICDTT! from the deck, then used Legacy to play Retcon.)

Maybe there are multiple ways to unlock? Either Plays or Draws? Definitely playing specific cards and Retcon is definitely one of them.
